subject: MAP: SOC 2 package delivery and security review - draft
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Tan <sophie.tan@aurelia.tech>, David Li <david.li@aurelia.tech>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-10T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: MAP: SOC 2 package delivery and security review - draft

Hi Sophie / David,

Great to speak with you today — thanks for the time. As discussed, attached is a first draft of the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) focused on the security review milestone and SOC 2 package delivery so we can keep the procurement timeline moving. High level summary below and a couple of asks to keep momentum: 

Key MAP milestone: Security review + SOC 2 package delivery
- Target: Provide SOC 2 package to Aurelia Tech for internal review
- Target close (for procurement checkpoint): 2026-12-03
- Dependencies: 1) Completed questionnaire from Aurelia (attached), 2) Evidence collection from Redwood security team, 3) Legal/Procurement review for standard DPA redlines
- Responsibilities:
  - Aurelia Tech: Return completed questionnaire, identify internal reviewer(s) and confirm any additional evidence needs
  - Redwood (Redwood security & Marissa): Deliver SOC2 questionnaire answers + evidence checklist, provide point-of-contact for follow-ups

Immediate asks: 
1) Sophie — can you confirm who on your security team will be the reviewer (name + email) and target date to return the completed questionnaire?
2) David — any specific evidence types your team needs beyond the standard checklist (e.g., network diagrams, penetration test reports)?
3) Both — please review the attached MAP draft and flag any adjustments to milestone dates or responsibilities.

Attachments included: SOC2-Questionnaire-AureliaTech.pdf (fillable), SOC2-Evidence-Checklist.xlsx, Redwood-MAP-v1.0.docx

I’ll loop in our security ops folks internally to start preparing the evidence bundle once we have the questionnaire back.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment stubs:
- SOC2-Questionnaire-AureliaTech.pdf (pdf, 1.1MB, fillable)
- SOC2-Evidence-Checklist.xlsx (xlsx, 45KB)
- Redwood-MAP-v1.0.docx (docx, 120KB)

From: Sophie Tan <sophie.tan@aurelia.tech>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: David Li <david.li@aurelia.tech>
Date: 2026-11-11T09:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP: SOC 2 package delivery and security review - draft

Hi Marissa — thanks for the recap and draft MAP. Quick answers from my side: 

1) Reviewer: David Li (david.li@aurelia.tech) will own the security review. He may loop in our infra lead (TBD).
2) Evidence needs: At a minimum we need the completed questionnaire, system architecture/network diagram, and a recent penetration test summary. Full Type II report would be ideal, but we understand smaller vendors may only provide a package — can you confirm what Redwood will be able to deliver?

I’ll review the MAP doc and get back with any date adjustments. For the questionnaire, I expect we can return it by 2026-11-18 if there are no major follow-ups.

Thanks,
Sophie
Director of IT Security | Aurelia Tech
sophie.tan@aurelia.tech

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-11-15T11:27:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: MAP: SOC 2 package delivery and security review - draft

Rafael / Laura — forwarding the MAP draft and Aurelia's initial reply. Sophie expects the completed questionnaire back by 11/18 and asked whether we can provide a Type II report or at least the standard evidence package + pen test summary. Can you confirm the following by COB 2026-11-18?

Action items for Redwood security ops:
- Rafael: Prepare the SOC 2 evidence bundle (logs, control descriptions, policy docs) and confirm what we can share publicly vs. gated. Provide a list of any missing artifacts and estimated delivery dates.
- Laura: Pull system architecture/network diagram and recent penetration test executive summary. If PT summary is not available for public sharing, confirm sanitized summary or alternative evidence.
- Marissa (me): I will coordinate delivery and share a secure link for the evidence bundle; I’ll also update the MAP milestone dates if needed.

Notes: Aurelia prefers an initial package by 2026-12-03 to meet their procurement checkpoint. If we can provide the Type II report, that would accelerate acceptance — if not, the evidence bundle + questionnaire + PT summary should suffice for their internal review.

Thanks — cc'd Sophie and David so they can see our internal timelines.

— Marissa

Attachment stubs forwarded: SOC2-Questionnaire-AureliaTech.pdf, SOC2-Evidence-Checklist.xlsx, Redwood-MAP-v1.0.docx

Below is the updated MAP milestone with responsibilities and expected delivery windows. Please confirm or flag any changes so we can close this milestone on your timeline.

Updated MAP milestone: Security review + SOC 2 package delivery
- Target procurement checkpoint: 2026-12-03
- Redwood deliverables (expected):
  - Completed SOC2 questionnaire (with control mappings) — 2026-11-24
  - Evidence bundle (logs, policies, control evidence) — 2026-11-30
  - System architecture diagram & PT executive summary — 2026-11-30
- Aurelia deliverables:
  - Return completed questionnaire / questions — 2026-11-27
  - Review evidence bundle & provide follow-up requests — 2026-12-01
- Open dependencies: confirmation on Type II report availability (Redwood Product is currently SOC 2: Type II expected later this quarter — update due 2026-11-25)

Attachments: SOC2-Questionnaire-AureliaTech.pdf, SOC2-Evidence-Checklist.xlsx, Redwood-MAP-v1.0.docx

Next steps: 
1) Sophie — confirm that the revised return date 11/27 works for your reviewers.
2) David — confirm if you need additional artifact types (e.g., full pen test report vs exec summary).
3) Rafael / Laura — once I have a secure link for the evidence bundle I will share it and mark delivered in HubSpot (link below).

HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/98765
